item.title: Threat assessment brief – Importation of Ebola disease cases caused by Bundibugyo virus to Kenya and Nigeria
item.description: This Threat Assessment Brief assesses the risk for people from the EU/EEA living in or travelling to Kenya and Nigeria, and the overall risk for the general EU/EEA population. It is intended for public health authorities in the EU/EEA.
item.dc:creator: ECDC

item.title: Rapid outbreak assessment – Multi-country outbreak of Salmonella Bovismorbificans ST377 infections linked to the consumption of alfalfa sprouted seeds
item.description: Between January and May 2026, 109 confirmed cases of Salmonella Bovismorbificans ST377 were reported from 10 European Union/European Economic Area (EU/EEA) countries (Austria, Belgium, Czechia, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Luxembourg, Spain and the Netherlands) and the United Kingdom.
item.dc:creator: ECDC
